description:
Explore a land filled with lost legends, ancient powers, and ferocious monsters in TUNIC, an isometric action game
about a small fox on a big adventure. Stranded on a mysterious beach, armed with only your own curiosity, you will
confront colossal beasts, collect strange and powerful items, and unravel long-lost secrets. Be brave, tiny fox!

5.0.0.description: # Version 5.0.0 ## Known Issues - Interacting with the Sealed Temple door in Fox Prince mode can result in a softlock if it sends you to the cutscene area. ### Backwards compatibility with existing seeds: - Single Player Randomizer: ❌ - Archipelago: ⚠️ - The tunic.apworld file was updated in this version. - This update is fully compatible with games generated on Archipelago 0.6.7 and the Archipelago website. - Save files started on Version 4.2.7 can be picked up where they were left off after updating, with the following exception: - For Entrance Rando seeds, set your spawn point at any save statue before updating, otherwise you may encounter a black screen when loading the file on 5.0.0. - If you generate a game using the 5.0.0 apworld, every Tunic player in that game must update to the 5.0.0 mod, even if they're not using the new settings. There are new filler item IDs in the apworld that will cause issues on the old mod. ## Check out everything new on the [Randomizer Website!](https://rando.tunic.run/) # Fox Prince (by @ScipioWright) ### A brand new Entrance Randomizer mode with features inspired by Blue Prince. (Not compatible with Archipelago.) - Every entrance you enter will prompt you with three entrances to choose from. Your choice will then be locked in for that transition for the rest of the seed. - New items have been added in this mode for use when choosing an entrance (dice for re-rolling, darts to pin an entrance for later) - Special thanks to fletchisafurry for their East Forest and Ziggurat map images! # Shuffle Enemy Drops + Shuffle Enemy Souls ### All enemies drop a check when defeated. Available in both Single Player and Archipelago. - Adds around 600 checks, with an additional "extra" option to include New Game+ and Nighttime enemies for ~100 more checks. - **Shuffling Enemy Souls** splits up the progression by making it so enemies do not appear in the world until their corresponding "soul" item is found. (Requires Enemy Drops to be shuffled.) - Poptracker support for enemy checks is in the works for a future update. - Unchecked enemies will have a differently colored Z-Target ring, and can still be found via the Seeking Spell. # Trick & Glitch Logic Toggle ladder storage, ice grappling, and/or laurels shortcuts in logic, with varying levels of difficulty. (These options already existed for Archipelago, but have now been ported to the standalone randomizer) ## Archipelago Updates - Added a "Connect Via Player Link" button on the main menu, which allows you to right click -> copy link on your player name from an Archipelago room page and connect with a single button press. - With the newest apworld, opening the archipelago launcher via the room page will now prompt you to launch either the text client, universal tracker, or TUNIC directly. Launching TUNIC this way will automatically connect you once the game loads to the title screen. - Room passwords do not get populated with the above methods and must still be manually entered. - Death Link messages have been overhauled and now more accurately describe what killed you. - The Laurels and Questagon hints now sync with the Archipelago text client. - Universal Tracker now supports Deferred Entrances for Entrance Rando. - Added fuse locations to the poptracker maps for Universal Tracker - Added location groups for all grass/breakable/enemy checks to the APworld - Minor logic fixes and tweaks in the APworld - Players can no longer be interrupted by other players sending them an item while typing holy cross codes. - Death/Trap Links can no longer be received during the credits - The potion-forming animation will no longer get stuck on repeat while receiving a bunch of items. # Quick Settings Redux ### The randomizer menu has received an overhaul, now providing easy access to every setting found within the mod. # Seeking Spell Options You can now filter what types of checks the seeking spell will search for, including: - In-Logic Checks - Default/Vanilla Checks - Grass - Breakables - Fuses & Bells - Enemies # Misc. Toggles - **CRT Filter**: Render the game with a CRT effect overlay - **Faster Item Queue**: For Archipelago, makes the item queue process faster and skip filler animations when receiving large amounts of items at once. - **Fool Trap Toggles**: You can now set each individual fool trap type to be either on/off/trap link only. There are a handful of new traps that were made specifically for trap link with non-tunic games that can now be enabled for yourself. New trap effects include CRT, Bald, Home (teleports you to overworld), Whoops!, W I D E, Zoom Out, Color Saturation, MP Depletion, Disarm (unequips all items), and Fast (speeds up the game). ## Other Changes & Bugfixes - Reduced the range of the Librarian and Heir swords. - Several optimizations to (hopefully) improve performance of the mod. - Added controller button mappings for the ending screen actions (release/collect/skip credits/hide stats). - The Heir can now be fought in Hexagon Quest. (Note: The logic does not account for this as it would normally.) - Fixed the cathedral elevator disappearing with shuffled fuses. - Added a tuning fork outside of the temple when ladders are shuffled in order to get back down from the upper right path. - Added a light source outside of the Cathedral Secret Legend door to highlight the chest. - Added ladder/fuse decorations near the overworld info sign depending on which is enabled. - The Chalkboard in the Sealed Temple now displays split counts for Overworld and Overworld Interiors. - Added an icon for the laurels-toggle item. - Added a small sfx/animation when unlocked abilities. - Fixed several ghost fox Trunic typos. - Added failsafe for wrong warping and getting stuck out of bounds due to the deathplane patch. - Added launch params to force the TUNC title screen or Mr Mayor mode (`-tunc` and `-mayor`) - Other things I am probably forgetting.
5.0.0.title: TUNIC Randomizer 5.0.0

5.0.1.description:
### Backwards compatibility with existing seeds: 
- Single Player: ❌
- Archipelago: ✅
  - The tunic apworld was updated in this version:
    - Fixed inconsistent rules for boss checks if shuffled enemy drops and combat logic were both enabled

# Changes
- Fixed a single player bug where switching from an entrance rando save file to a non-entrance rando save file in the same session would cause seed bleed and corrupt the item placements.
- Fixed a visual bug when switching between save files that would cause the wrong freestanding item models/chest colors to appear on the first load.
- Fixed a couple of Fox Prince logic bugs.
  - The Hero's Laurels are now prevented from appearing at the `Secret Gathering Place - 20 Fairies` check in Fox Prince due to it being too restrictive and causing issues.
- The Dice and Dart items now appear in the inventory screen in Fox Prince.
- Interacting with the Sealed Temple door will no longer send you to the intro cutscene ghost area.
  - This was previously always the case when playing Hexagon Quest, but now applies in all modes.
- The seeking spell will no longer target the coin wells if the filter option for default checks is disabled.
- To avoid confusion, the bald fox trap no longer removes the laurels from the player.
5.0.1.title: TUNIC Randomizer 5.0.1

5.0.2.description:
### Backwards compatibility with existing seeds: 
- Single Player: ❌
- Archipelago: ✅
  - The tunic apworld was updated in this version

# Changes
- Adjusted how Fox Prince determines entrance choices to hopefully improve performance in late game when there are fewer entrances remaining.
- Fixed a freeze that could happen when choosing entrances in Fox Prince if Laurels were set to 10 Fairies.
- Fixed a bug with Mystery Seeds where it could enable Fox Prince but _not_ Entrance Rando, causing various issues and softlocks.
- Fixed a few instances of fairies in Ruined Atoll and Ziggurat that wouldn't aggro unless you threw a bomb or brought other enemies close to them; they should now wake up just from walking near them.
- Various enemy soul-related logic fixes in the apworld:
  - Shop checks now properly require the rudeling soul
  - Bomb walls could rarely require the wrong enemy soul if ice grappling logic was set to hard
  - The lower frog in the frog stairway scene could sometimes appear as in logic without the Ladders to Frog's Domain or the Magic Orb
5.0.2.title: TUNIC Randomizer 5.0.2
